nodes.name: description_label
nodes.text:
Converts liquid inputs into pressurized Steam gas. Water produces Steam at a 1:1 ratio; Cryofluid takes longer and produces 50% more Steam. The liquid input tank and Steam gas tank each store 64,000 units.

Filled Water or Cryofluid containers go in the upper-left slot and their empty containers leave below it. Empty gas capsules go in the upper-right slot; a filled 8,000-unit Steam Capsule leaves below it.

Item I/O:
§9Liquid Container Input§r and §bGas Container Input§r accept containers.
§cContainer Return§r and §cSteam Container Output§r expose processed containers.
§9Input All§r and §cOutput All§r expose both pairs.

Liquid I/O:
§9Liquid Input§r accepts Water or Cryofluid.

Gas I/O:
§cSteam Output§r exposes the Steam tank.
